_comment: The exceptions to arthome-check-symbols, each with its reason.
A path belongs here only when the symbols are content we do not author. Adding one to make
the gate pass is the one use this file does not have.

allow.reason: The five design mockups, byte for byte from the read-only design handoff. Their symbols are the product's interface (a confirmation tick, a close cross), not our prose.
Copied byte for byte from the handoff's shared/, which the mission declares read only. The i18n dictionaries carry interface symbols as copy.
Screens extracted verbatim from the mockups, interface symbols included. A symbol in one of our comments here is missed; the price of not forking the copy.
